title: NeoCecilio Pack
body:
A vanilla+ experience intended for a fresh new look at Minecraft!

Includes mods such as:
- Farmer's Delight
- Travelers' Backpack
- Stellarity
- Incendium
- Distant Horizons
- ... and many more!

I really hope you enjoy your time with NeoCecilio Pack, as it's made with fun above all. Expect constant updates if needed!
